description: Lane D's G-8 write constraints as WRITE_ADMISSION input (example; data only). Lane D writes only its own laned/* branches. Main, merges, force-pushes, history rewrites, registry generation bumps, settings and workflow_dispatch are not file writes and are outside this predicate; they stay governed by G-8 itself.

rules.repair: push only to a laned/* branch you own and open a DRAFT pull request; never main
